verdict.rationale: Together publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("Together APIs", v2.0.0) at docs.together.ai/openapi.yaml. It is synced from the togethercomputer/openapi sources and listed under "OpenAPI Specs" in llms.txt. The per-endpoint API reference is generated from it. The probe's 404s were only for .json/swagger paths, so they don't contradict the YAML spec. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on fetch confirming the openapi.yaml download, and no JSON variant at the standard paths.
